recipes.title: Web search (news & current events)
recipes.description: Author wants fresh information from the public web: latest news, headlines, what happened today, or current facts that need citations. Not CMS repository work.

context: Call WebSearch in the first tool round with a focused query built from the author's exact words.
If the author pasted a specific http(s) URL, you may use FetchHttpUrl for that URL only — not instead of WebSearch for open-ended news.
action: Summarize findings in clear prose with source titles and URLs from the tool result. Do not invent links.
confirmation: Note knowledge cutoff vs search date when relevant. Offer to help apply insights to CMS content only if the author asks.

recipes.title: Site content search
recipes.description: Author wants to find or summarize existing pages and components in the Crafter CMS site named by Working CMS site metadata or the current Studio site (indexed authoring search + content lookup), including when there is no open-preview repository anchor on this turn. Not the open web and not a write.

context: Call ResearchSiteContent in the first tool round with siteId and a focused query from the author's words.
action: Answer from hits: cite repository paths and titles; use contentExcerpt and indexSnippet — do not invent paths.
confirmation: Offer GetContent on specific paths if the author wants to edit; do not WriteContent unless they ask to change content.

recipes.title: General knowledge (LLM)
recipes.description: Author wants explanation, comparison, research, or background from model knowledge — not live web headlines and not editing the repository.

action: Answer from general knowledge in clear prose (bullets ok). Do not call CMS repository tools on this turn.

When they ask to **draft** or **write** a post/article **in chat** (no create/new page/new item in the repo), compose that draft as markdown prose in the same reply after any research or comparison — **not** ListStudioContentTypes / WriteContent.
If the question needs live/current data, say so and suggest the author ask for a web search instead.
confirmation: Keep the reply self-contained; mention training cutoff when dates matter.

recipes.title: Describe this page (read-only)
recipes.description: Author wants a summary or explanation of the page or component currently open in Studio (anchored /site/.../*.xml). Read repository XML and answer in prose. Not a write, not site-wide search, not open web.
recipes.matchedUserPrelude: [Studio — read-only page inquiry] Summarize what this anchored page is about using prefetch or GetContent XML. Answer in clear prose only. Do not WriteContent, update_template, or chase CSS/FTL paths unless the author asks to change something.

hints: Prefetch loads pageItem (XML) for the anchored path when available.
If prefetch already includes full contentXml for the anchored path, do not call GetContent again on that path.

action: Answer what the page is about from the item XML and any referenced components the prefetch or tools returned. Plain prose for the author.
confirmation: Do not call WriteContent. Optional GetPreviewHtml only if it helps describe what visitors see.

recipes.title: Modify page or component content
recipes.description: Change author-visible copy, tone, grammar, or CMS field values stored in page/component XML (title_t, body_html, navLabel, SEO fields, component text fields, etc.). Use when the deliverable is different words or field values in content items — not visual styling, CSS, stylesheets, or FreeMarker/layout code. An open page anchor alone does not imply this recipe; infer whether the author means copy in XML vs presentation in CSS/FTL.
dontMatchHints: did not ask you to change

hints: Prefetch binds pageItem (item XML) and pageForm (form definition) for this turn.
If the author gives a page URL, title, or internal name, resolve the correct repository path before GetContent — they may not mean the item currently open in Studio.
Load the target item with GetContent (and GetContentTypeFormDefinition with contentPath when the form model matters).

action: Use update_content or GetContent → revise XML → WriteContent; preserve <page>/<component> structure and node-selector shapes. After a write, prefer {{current.pageItem}} over {{initial.pageItem}} for the edited XML snapshot.
confirmation: When an Engine preview URL exists, use GetPreviewHtml after substantive writes affecting rendered output.

recipes.title: Restore fields from version history
recipes.description: Author wants specific fields (copy, hero image) restored from a prior Studio version without rolling back the entire item. Use FindContentVersion or GetContentVersionHistory, CompareContentVersions optional, GetContent at versionNumber, merge fields into HEAD, WriteContent.

context: Confirm siteId and anchored repository path. Call FindContentVersion (contentContains, imagePathContains, or field criteria) or GetContentVersionHistory to pick versionNumber. Optionally CompareContentVersions (HEAD vs version) to show what changed.
action: GetContent with commitRef set to the target versionNumber to read historical XML. GetContent on HEAD for current XML. Merge only the requested fields (e.g. hero_title_html, hero_text_html, title_t, hero_image_s) from history into current. WriteContent the merged full item. Do NOT call revert_change. When restoring a prior image, reuse hero_image_s from history or a known repositoryPath from earlier GenerateImage — do NOT call GenerateImage.
confirmation: GetPreviewHtml after WriteContent when a preview URL exists. Do not claim success on HTTP 500.

recipes.title: Revert entire item to previous version
recipes.description: Author wants the **entire** content item rolled back via revert_change. Not for restoring only copy or an image field — use restore_fields_from_version instead.

context: Confirm siteId and anchored repository path. Call GetContentVersionHistory.
action: Use revert_change only for a full-item rollback. For copy-only or image-only restore, use GetContentVersionHistory → GetContent(version) → merge → WriteContent instead.
confirmation: GetPreviewHtml after revert when a preview URL exists. Do not claim success on HTTP 500.

recipes.title: Generate image (bitmap)
recipes.description: Author wants a new AI-generated image with a **specific subject they named** (e.g. “image of a red fox”, “draw a blue circle”). Not when the subject must come from an anchored page (“generate an image for this page”) — use plan mode and GetContent first.

context: Use the author's explicit image subject in the GenerateImage prompt. This recipe is for subjects the author named — not anchored-page art (that case uses plan mode and GetContent first).
action: Call GenerateImage with a concrete prompt from the author's words; optional size/quality only when the author specified them.
confirmation: Wrap up in short prose only — the bitmap appears in the Studio chat image strip, not markdown image syntax.

recipes.title: Stylesheet / CSS change
recipes.description: Author wants visual presentation changed in stylesheets: layout, typography, spacing, themes, branding, CSS variables, selectors, or other values under /static-assets/ or linked CSS discovered from the page template — not CMS copy or field values in page/component XML. Success means stylesheet files were edited and preview reflects the change.

context: GetContent on anchored page/component XML only to read display-template and discover linked CSS under /static-assets/ (from FTL, head fragments, or GetPreviewHtml). Page XML is context — not the stylesheet write target.
action: GetContent on each stylesheet path you will edit. Change only what the author asked for — preserve selectors, class names, and file structure unless they requested otherwise. WriteContent on .css/.scss paths only; do not WriteContent page/component XML when the deliverable is stylesheet changes.
confirmation: GetPreviewHtml when preview URL is available to verify the visual change.

recipes.matchedUserPrelude:
[Studio — stylesheet / CSS change]

**Goal:** Update linked stylesheet file(s) under `/static-assets/` (or paths discovered from FTL/head fragments). The anchored page XML is **context only** — **do not WriteContent** `/site/.../*.xml` unless the author explicitly asked for copy changes.

**Surgical edit workflow (mandatory):**
1. **Discover** — **GetContent** on page/template/head only to find exact `.css` / `.scss` paths linked from this page.
2. **Read baseline** — **GetContent** on **each** stylesheet path you will edit. Treat `contentXml` as the **raw CSS file body** (not XML).
3. **Edit in place** — Start from that **full** GetContent body. Change **only** what the author asked for (color values, CSS variables, etc.). **Do not** rename selectors, remove rules, reorder blocks, or rewrite layout/spacing/typography unless requested.
4. **Write full file** — **WriteContent** with the **entire** edited CSS string in `contentXml`. **Never** send placeholders (`/*placeholder*/`), XML declarations (`<?xml …?>`), stubs, or partial snippets. The server rejects truncated or restructured files.
5. **Verify** — **GetPreviewHtml** when a preview URL exists.

**Plan lines** must name stylesheet paths and value-level edits — not “save page XML”.

recipes.title: Template / display (FTL) change
recipes.description: Author wants how the page renders in code changed: FreeMarker templates, layout markup, listing shells, display-template structure, or component template wiring — not CMS field copy and not stylesheet work (use stylesheet_change for the latter).

context: GetContent on page/component XML; read display-template; follow node-selector and component references from the page XML to component templates when the shell is not the listing.
action: Read templates with GetContent or analyze_template (read-only) before update_template; persist with WriteContent on .ftl paths.
confirmation: GetPreviewHtml when preview URL is available.

recipes.title: Build page feature (section / widget)
recipes.description: Author wants a new on-page feature or section (chatbot, form, search box, carousel, embed, widget, etc.) that usually spans the Crafter stack: content type and component item when needed, wire into the page sections_o, FreeMarker display template, CSS under /static-assets/, and Groovy REST/controller under /scripts/ when the feature needs server logic. Not copy-only field edits (modify_page_content), not stylesheet-only work (stylesheet_change), not template-only markup without new content (template_display_change), and not a brand-new top-level page URL with no feature on an existing page (new_content_item).
recipes.matchedUserPrelude:
[Studio — build page feature (multi-surface)]

**Goal:** Deliver a working feature on the anchored page across every layer the author needs — typically **content model + items**, **FTL**, **CSS**, and **Groovy backend** when server logic is required.

**Plan first:** Stream **## Plan** with **📋** lines in execution order — one verifiable outcome per layer (model, content items, template, styles, backend, preview). Then **tool_calls** in the same message.

**Layers (include only what the feature needs; do not skip required layers):**
1. **Content model** — **ListStudioContentTypes** / **GetContentTypeFormDefinition**; create or extend component type + form definition via **update_content_type** then **WriteContent** when no suitable type exists.
2. **Content items** — component item under `/site/components/...`; add reference to page **sections_o** (or correct collection) via **GetContent** → **WriteContent** on page + component paths.
3. **Template** — **analyze_template** / **update_template** or **GetContent** on `.ftl`; **WriteContent** on display templates with `@crafter` / XB markup.
4. **CSS** — discover linked styles from FTL or `/static-assets/`; **WriteContent** on stylesheet paths.
5. **Groovy backend** — when the feature needs API/controller logic: **GetContent** on existing `/scripts/rest/` or `/scripts/controllers/` patterns; **WriteContent** on new `.groovy` scripts.
6. **Verify** — **GetPreviewHtml** when preview URL exists.

Use **GetCrafterizingPlaybook** when you need the full crafterization checklist. **Project authoring context** wins on site-specific XML shape.

hints: Prefetch loads anchored page XML and form definition when Studio anchors /site/.../*.xml.
Read sections_o allowed content types and display-template paths before creating new component types or items.
Call GetCrafterizingPlaybook when unsure about content-type vs component vs template order for this site.

action: Emit ## Plan with ordered outcomes for content model, items, FTL, CSS, Groovy (as needed), then execute with tool_calls.
Content model: ListStudioContentTypes and GetContentTypeFormDefinition; update_content_type + WriteContent on form-definition when creating a new component type.
Content items: WriteContent on new component XML and update page sections_o (or parent collection) on the anchored page.
Template: analyze_template or GetContent on .ftl paths from display-template; update_template then WriteContent for markup changes.
CSS: GetContent on linked /static-assets/ stylesheets; WriteContent with preserved selectors/class names.
Groovy: when the feature needs server endpoints, WriteContent under /scripts/rest/ or /scripts/controllers/ following existing site patterns from GetContent reads.
Do not treat a feature build as modify_page_content copy-only — implement every layer the feature requires.
confirmation: GetPreviewHtml when Engine preview URL is available.
Summarize repository paths touched at each layer (content type, component item, page reference, FTL, CSS, Groovy).

recipes.title: Publish entire site / first go-live
recipes.description: Author wants to publish the whole site, everything, or first-time go-live — not a read-only page summary and not a single item unless they narrowed scope after first publish.

context: Confirm siteId and publishingTarget (default live). If Studio metadata says the site has never been published, publishScope=all is required.
action: Call publish_content with publishScope=all (PublishService.publishAll) for entire site / first publish. Use publishScope=bulk and bulkRootPath=/site only when publish all is unavailable and bulk go-live is appropriate. Do not pass only the open preview contentPath for entire-site requests.
confirmation: Report publishScope, initialPublish flag, and path counts from the tool result — never claim entire site published if publishScope was item or only one path was deployed.

recipes.title: Publish or go live
recipes.description: Author wants to publish one item, a list of paths, or go live without sitewide / first-publish scope.

context: Confirm siteId, publishingTarget, and scope: single path, paths array, or bulk subtree — not entire site unless author asked.
action: publish_content: publishScope=item with path/contentPath for one item; publishScope=paths with paths/contentPaths array for a list (one deploy); publishScope=bulk with bulkRootPath for subtree. Avoid discovery reads when context already has paths.
confirmation: Summarize publishScope, path(s), and tool outcome — do not claim entire site if only one path or a short list was published.

recipes.title: Create item from prior chat draft
recipes.description: Turn 2 after prior assistant prose in chat: persist **[Prior conversation]** as a **new** repository item. Author may say “make a post”, “save this”, “thanks — publish it”, etc. — the word **draft** is not required. **Not** generic “new page” with no prior assistant article; **not** research-only chat.
recipes.matchedUserPrelude:
[Studio — create **new** repository item from prior chat draft]

**Goal:** One successful **WriteContent** with a **full** `<component>` or `<page>` XML document. Required envelope: `<content-type>`, `<file-name>`, `<merge-strategy>`, `<objectId>`, `<objectGroupId>`, `<internal-name>`. **Not** a fragment or markdown-only body.

**Generate XML — do not copy siblings:** **GetContentTypeFormDefinition** for the resolved type and every nested type on the form. Follow **Project authoring context** when it defines element order and nested-component XML for this site. **Do not** **GetContent** an existing item to copy structure, field values, or body text.

**Copy (from [Prior conversation] only — verbatim):** Read the last **Assistant** reply for title, body, and slug. Do not summarize or rephrase. Map into form fields using **GetContentTypeFormDefinition** — the server does not extract title/body for you. New UUIDs for **objectId** / **objectGroupId**.

**Path:** **ListStudioContentTypes** → match type. **quickCreatePath** from form definition. Choose **file-name** / slug from the title you read; **ContentExists** on that **new** path — expect **false**. **ResearchSiteContent** only for reference targets (bios, taxonomy keys).

**Nested fields:** Per form defs and **Project authoring context** (inline components, RTE `*_html`, node-selectors).

If **[Prior conversation]** has no saveable article in the last assistant reply, stop and ask the author to regenerate the draft.

**Images:** Omit or leave empty required image-picker fields — **WriteContent** fills placeholders. **GenerateImage** only when the author asked for art.

hints: Turn 2: persist prior-turn draft as a **new** file. The Studio preview anchor is context only — not the write target.
Draft prose is the last **Assistant** reply in **[Prior conversation]** (any headings/labels the author used). Copy verbatim — do not summarize, rephrase, or invent body or title text.

action: If **[Prior conversation]** has no full article in the last **Assistant** reply, tell the author to regenerate the draft in chat before **WriteContent**.
**GetContentTypeFormDefinition** for the resolved type and every nested type referenced on the parent form.
**ContentExists** on the planned new path (expect **false**). **ResearchSiteContent** only when you need a reference path or allowed taxonomy keys — not to load another item’s XML as a template.

Build **contentXml** from form definitions + **Project authoring context**: complete root envelope, new UUIDs, nested inline/referenced components per field types. Put the **full verbatim** prior draft in the correct RTE `*_html` field(s) — every paragraph, no edits. Do not copy another item’s field values or rewrite the draft.
**Images:** Omit or leave empty every required **image-picker** field in **WriteContent** — the server applies the sample placeholder on write. **GenerateImage** only when the author asked for art.

**WriteContent** once to the **new** path under **quickCreatePath**. Server **write verification** rejects incomplete **contentXml** — fix tool errors and retry; do not finish until **WriteContent** returns ok.
confirmation: Report repository path, slug, and that body came from the prior chat draft (not a cloned sibling).

recipes.title: Create new page or component
recipes.description: Author asks to **create** a new repository item (new URL or new component in Studio) **without** copying a prior assistant reply. **Not** “looks great — make a post” after chat prose — use **new_content_item_from_chat_draft**. **Not** chat-only research prose — **llm_research** (tools off).
recipes.matchedUserPrelude: [Studio — create new repository item] Server prefetch resolves **contentTypeId**, form definition, **writeContentMaterials**, taxonomy keys, and suggested path. **Fast path:** emit **native tool_calls** with **one WriteContent** — **full** contentXml inline (skip ## Plan JSON placeholders). Populate every **requiredFieldIds** entry and minSize collections with **original** author copy (multiple paragraphs in repeat RTE fields). **WriteContent** is rejected when contentXml is incomplete or non-compliant.

hints: ListStudioContentTypes (siteId only) then exact catalog match; GetContentTypeFormDefinition for resolved contentTypeId and nested types; Project authoring context for site-specific XML shape.

action: Resolve **contentTypeId** via **ListStudioContentTypes** (exact catalog match). **GetContentTypeFormDefinition** for **quickCreatePath**, required fields, and each nested/inline type.

Build **contentXml** from form definitions + **Project authoring context** (not from an arbitrary existing item of the same type). **GetContent** only for verified taxonomy/shared paths the project names.

Required image-picker without art instructions: **GeneratePlaceholderImage** → **`dataUrl`** in **WriteContent** (or omit for default placeholder). **GenerateImage** only when the author explicitly asked for specific generated art.
**WriteContent** at a new path under **quickCreatePath**; optional **GetPreviewHtml** in confirmation.
confirmation: Tell the author how to preview the new route; optional GetPreviewHtml.

recipes.title: Translate or localize content
recipes.description: Author explicitly asks to translate or localize page/component copy into another language. Use TranslateContentItem or TranslateContentBatch (with ListContentTranslationScope for full-page scope) — not update_content or same-language rewrite via GetContent→WriteContent.

hints: When the author means full page / everything visible / this page copy: ListContentTranslationScope once on the anchored contentPath, then TranslateContentBatch (same target language for every path) or TranslateContentItem per path — never call ListContentTranslationScope twice in one turn without a write in between.
When scope is only the open repository item: TranslateContentItem on that contentPath is enough; skip ListContentTranslationScope unless they expand scope mid-task.
GetContentTypeFormDefinition only when you need unknown field ids.

action: TranslateContentItem or TranslateContentBatch with explicit target language/locale from the author message; reuse the first ListContentTranslationScope result for batch paths.
confirmation: Optional GetPreviewHtml when preview URL exists after substantive translation writes.
